statement.zh: 围住所立者排除不息的变化：跨过被围住的步，任何水平变化都使所立者的总水平下降；每步立着的与活跃的有限多、生起者体现的平衡耗散世界被围住所立者时，归于停息不能被否证，交换也不复现；八个前提既不决定被围住，也不决定开放。
statement.en: Enclosure excludes endless change: over enclosed steps any change of standing lowers the total, so an enclosed, balanced, dissipative world with finite censuses and embodied arising cannot be refuted to come to rest, its exchange not recurring; the premises decide neither enclosure nor openness.

laws.zh: 每步立着的条件被不重复地列出时，称一步围住所立者，当某个不重复、跨过该步封闭的家族包含该步前后立着的每个条件。
laws.en: Where what stands at each step is listed, each once, a step is enclosed around what stands when some family without repetition, closed across the step, holds every condition standing before or after it.

laws.zh: 在平衡与耗散之下，跨过这样的步，所立者的总水平下降至少为取用该家族的形成数，所以不上升；任何条件的水平上升或下降都使它下降：上升被给予，而那里给予需要取用；下降被取用。
laws.en: Under balance and dissipation, across such a step the total standing falls by at least the number of formations taking from that family, so it does not rise, and any condition's standing rising or falling lowers it: a rise is given to, and giving needs uptake there; a fall is taken from.

laws.zh: 所以从某步起每步都围住所立者时，没有条件的水平在任意晚的步变化；每一步的围住只需不被否定，因为比较的是自然数。
laws.en: So where every step from some step on is enclosed around what stands, no condition's standing changes at arbitrarily late steps; each enclosure need only be not refuted, since what is compared are numbers.

laws.zh: 读于世界：所立者被列出、生起者体现、平衡、耗散且从某步起每步围住所立者时，生起从某步起停止不能被否证。
laws.en: Read of worlds: where what stands is listed, whatever arises is embodied, the flow balances and dissipates and every step from some step on is enclosed around what stands, that arising stops from some step on cannot be refuted.

laws.zh: 停息定理：有活动的普查与所立者的普查、生起者体现、流平衡且耗散的世界，从某步起每步都围住所立者时，世界从某步起停息（World.RestsFrom）不能被否证，所以生起与止息都不复现。
laws.en: The rest theorem: a world with a census of what is active and of what stands, whose arising is embodied, with a balanced, dissipative flow, in which every step from some step on is enclosed around what stands, is such that its resting from some step on (World.RestsFrom) cannot be refuted, so neither arising nor ceasing recurs.

laws.zh: 水平从某步起不再变化不能被否证，所以体现的生起从某步起停止不能被否证：并非此后每一步之后再有生起都不能被否证。
laws.en: That standing stops changing from some step on cannot be refuted, so that embodied arising stops from some step on cannot be refuted either: it is not the case that after every step from then on a later arising stays unrefuted.

laws.zh: 普查是覆盖活跃者的列表，在其下止息复现使此后每一步之后的生起都不能被否证，这一不能被否证的停止否证它，所以止息从某步起停止也不能被否证，不用判定程序；World.comes_to_rest_unrefuted_from 只要求一个列表在此后每一步覆盖活跃者。
laws.en: The census is a list covering what is active, under which ceasing recurring leaves a later arising unrefuted after every step, which the unrefuted stopping refutes, so that ceasing stops from some step on cannot be refuted either, with no decision procedure; World.comes_to_rest_unrefuted_from asks only for a list covering what is active at each step from then on.

laws.zh: 两种普查都不可少：attrition 中没有任何东西立着、没有流，满足其余每个前提，每步都围住所立者，而止息复现。
laws.en: Both censuses are needed: in attrition nothing stands and nothing flows, every other premise holds, every step is enclosed around what stands, and ceasing recurs.

laws.zh: throughput 中活跃的被列出、生起者体现、平衡、耗散、每步围住每个曾活跃的关系项，而每个未燃的燃料都立着，所立者不能被列出，生起不息；embodiedThroughput 是同一流而每个关系项体现，每步被围住，没有普查，生起不息。
laws.en: In throughput what is active is listed, whatever arises is embodied, the flow balances and dissipates and every step is enclosed around every relatum ever active, yet every unburnt fuel stands, so what stands cannot be listed, and arising never ceases; in embodiedThroughput, the same flow with every relatum embodied, every step is enclosed, nothing active can be listed, and arising never ceases.

laws.zh: 所以世界本身不必有限，但每步立着的与活跃的须有限多；在停息这样不能被否证的世界中，曾经活跃的与曾经立着的都不是无界多，不用判定程序：停息定理比有限世界多涵盖的，只是从不立着、从不活动的关系项。
laws.en: So the world itself need not be finite, but finitely many must stand and finitely many be active at each step; in a world whose rest is so unrefuted, not unboundedly many relata are ever active and not unboundedly many ever stand, with no decision procedure: beyond finite worlds the rest theorem covers only relata that never stand or act.

laws.zh: 较强的形式，有一个列表列出曾经成立的全部成员，一般地需要全知：若每个每步被列出、开始成立不复现的规定都有这样的列表，即使每步至多列出一个成员、开始成立至多一次，有限全知原则 LPO 就成立。
laws.en: The stronger form, some list holding every member that ever holds, needs omniscience in general: if every determination listed at each step whose coming to hold does not recur had such a list, even one listing at most one member at each step and coming to hold at most once, the limited principle of omniscience LPO would hold.

laws.zh: 交换也不复现：跨过围住所立者的步，参与的形成取用或给予任何东西，都使所立者的总水平下降，因为被围住的家族持有它所交换的，而在耗散之下给予它需要从它取用；所以从某步起每步都不被否定地围住所立者时，没有形成在任意晚的步取用或给予。
laws.en: The exchange does not recur either: across a step enclosed around what stands, a formation taking part that takes or gives anything lowers the total standing, since the enclosing family holds what it exchanges and under dissipation giving to it needs taking from it; so where every step from some step on is, not refutably, enclosed around what stands, no formation takes or gives at arbitrarily late steps.

laws.zh: 这只需所立者的普查、平衡、耗散与被围住，不需要活动的普查，也不需要体现；其中每一个都不可少，缺少它时其余都成立而交换在任意晚的步复现：没有被围住，exposed 满足全部八个前提。
laws.en: This needs only the census of what stands, balance, dissipation and enclosure, neither the census of what is active nor embodiment, and each of the four is needed, the others holding and the exchange recurring without it: without enclosure in exposed, which meets all eight premises.

laws.zh: 没有耗散，Flow 的循环中唯一的条件始终立着，流平衡，每步都围住它；没有平衡，leaking 耗散，每步都围住持有水平的一侧；没有所立者的普查，throughput 平衡、耗散，每步被围住，而所立者不能被列出。
laws.en: Without dissipation in the cycle of Becoming.Flow, its one condition standing throughout, the flow balanced and every step enclosed around it; without balance in leaking, dissipative, every step enclosed around the side holding the standing; without the census of what stands in throughput, balanced, dissipative and enclosed at every step, what stands not being listable.

laws.zh: 它的情形：有限世界列出所立者，每步都围住它，有限世界的停息 World.rests_unrefuted（Becoming.Space）陈述同一结论，其关系项覆盖活跃者，不用判定程序。
laws.en: Its cases: a finite world lists what stands and is enclosed around it at every step, and the finite rest, World.rests_unrefuted of Becoming.Space, states the same conclusion of finite worlds, its relata covering what is active, with no decision procedure.

laws.zh: 每个关系项都体现时，活动的普查就是所立者的普查；被围住的步不是不围住所立者，所以从某步起每步都被围住即可，不需要判定相等。
laws.en: Where every relatum is embodied, the census of what is active lists what stands; an enclosed step is not not enclosed around what stands, so enclosure from some step on suffices, with no decision of equality.

laws.zh: 反过来读，这样的世界生起不息时，并非从某步起每步都被围住：它不从任何一步起都被围住。
laws.en: Read the other way, arising without end in such a world is incompatible with every step from some step on being enclosed: it is enclosed from no step on.

laws.zh: 八个前提既不决定被围住，也不决定开放：Shuttle 的两侧另外在每步从无限多个地关系项各取一个单位再还回，满足 Becoming.Premises 的全部八个前提，生起不息；没有一步被围住，所以只在被围住的步上约束的耗散在任何一步都不约束。
laws.en: The eight premises decide neither enclosure nor openness: the sides of Shuttle, also taking a unit from each of infinitely many ground relata and giving it back at every step, meet all eight premises of Becoming.Premises and keep arising without end; no step is enclosed, so dissipation, which binds only at enclosed steps, binds at none.

laws.zh: 它的总水平每步都是一，持有者每步下降，地的关系项水平为零。
laws.en: Its total standing is one at every step, the holder falling across each, and the ground relata stand at nothing.

laws.zh: 开放连同八个前提也不给出生起不息：一个持有者在每步从每个地关系项取一个单位再还回，满足八个前提，没有一步被围住，而什么都不生起、不止息；始终活跃的互利者满足全部八个而每步都被围住，生起不复现。
laws.en: Nor does openness with the eight give arising without end: a holder taking a unit from each ground relatum and giving it back at every step meets the eight with no step enclosed, and nothing arises or ceases; mutualists active throughout meet all eight with every step enclosed and arising does not recur.

laws.zh: 每个前提都起约束的 hatch（map-of-premises 的 hatch_binds）中子代生起、亲代止息，之后每步都被围住，世界不有限，它的地关系项闲置，而它从某步起停息不能被否证。
laws.en: In hatch, where every premise binds (hatch_binds of map-of-premises), the child arises and the parent ceases, every step is enclosed, and that the world, though not finite, its ground relata idle, rests from some step on cannot be refuted.

laws.zh: 每个前提都起约束并不带来停息：在每步一个成员替换另一个的只闭合一次的队列（whole-law-of-counting 的 World.onceClosedQueue）中每个前提都起约束，生起与止息都复现。
laws.en: Every premise binding does not bring rest: in a queue closed once in which one member replaces another at every step (World.onceClosedQueue of whole-law-of-counting) every premise binds, and arising and ceasing both recur.

laws.zh: 这些规律对每个世界有局部形式：所立者有普查；从某步起每步不被否定所立者下降（闭合时为交换）；对流不加前提；Flow.change_stops_unrefuted_around、exchange_not_recurring_around（以及经它们的 World.arising_stops_unrefuted）是它们的推论。
laws.en: The laws hold of every world in a local form: a census of what stands and, from some step on, it not refuted that what stands runs down (closed, for the exchange), with no premise on the flow; Flow.change_stops_unrefuted_around, exchange_not_recurring_around (and World.arising_stops_unrefuted through them) are their corollaries.

laws.zh: 前提只是给出局部条件的一种方式：对每个世界的确切形式见 laws-of-one-step，那里下降不需要封闭，本记录的水平的停息定理是它的推论。
laws.en: The premises are one way of supplying the local condition: the exact form for every world is in laws-of-one-step, where running down needs no closure, and this record's standing rest theorems are its corollaries.

hypotheses.zh: 水平的规律（`Flow.change_stops_unrefuted_around`）：平衡；耗散；所立者的普查（每步立着的条件被不重复地列出，所以每步只有有限多个立着）；从某步起每步都围住所立者。
hypotheses.en: The standing law (`Flow.change_stops_unrefuted_around`): balance; dissipation; a census of what stands (the conditions standing at each step listed, each once, so finitely many stand at each step); every step from some step on enclosed around what stands.

hypotheses.zh: 读于世界。生起停止不能被否证（arising_stops_unrefuted）：所立者的普查与生起者体现。
hypotheses.en: Read of worlds. Arising stopping unrefuted (arising_stops_unrefuted): a census of what stands and whatever arises embodied.

hypotheses.zh: 停息定理（comes_to_rest_unrefuted）：另加活动的普查；不要求活动可判定（P58），普查只作覆盖活跃者的列表用（comes_to_rest_unrefuted_from）。
hypotheses.en: The rest theorem (comes_to_rest_unrefuted): also a census of what is active; activity need not be decided (P58), the census serving only as a list covering what is active (comes_to_rest_unrefuted_from).

hypotheses.zh: rests_unrefuted_around、rests_unrefuted_enclosed、arising_opens：活动的普查与每个关系项都体现，二者给出所立者的普查；不要求判定相等。
hypotheses.en: rests_unrefuted_around, rests_unrefuted_enclosed, arising_opens: a census of what is active and every relatum embodied, which together give the census of what stands; no decision of equality is needed.

hypotheses.zh: exposed_world、exposed_standing、openness_contingent、rest_needs_census 与 rest_needs_standing 是关于具体世界的陈述，不加前提。
hypotheses.en: exposed_world, exposed_standing, openness_contingent, rest_needs_census and rest_needs_standing are statements about particular worlds, with no premise.

does_not_show.zh: 交换归于停息陈述为交换不在任意晚的步发生（复现的否定），不是某步之后没有交换，后者需要判定。
does_not_show.en: The exchange coming to rest is stated as no exchange at arbitrarily late steps (a negated recurrence), not as a step after which none occurs, which would need a decision.

does_not_show.zh: 满足停息定理条件的世界中曾经立着或活跃的不是无界多，列出全部的列表一般地需要全知，所以推广只在于闲置的关系项。
does_not_show.en: In a world meeting the rest theorem's conditions not unboundedly many relata ever stand or act, a list holding all of them needing omniscience in general, so the generalization lies only in idle relata.

does_not_show.zh: 开放连同八个前提不充分，每个前提都起约束也不充分。
does_not_show.en: Openness with the eight premises does not suffice for arising without end, nor does every premise binding bring rest.

does_not_show.zh: exposed 中三个前提空成立，这是耗散只约束被围住的交换这一表示特点，而不是对实际开放系统的描述。
does_not_show.en: In exposed three premises hold vacuously, a feature of representing dissipation as binding only enclosed exchange, not a description of actual open systems.

does_not_show.zh: 量是自然数：耗散每个取用的步失去一个整单位；量取实数时损失可以几何地缩小，停息不成立，第二定律也不给每步的最小损失。
does_not_show.en: Amounts are natural numbers: dissipation loses a whole unit per taking step; with real amounts losses can shrink geometrically and rest fails, and the second law gives no least loss per step.

detail.zh: exposed：满足全部八个前提，没有一步被围住，生起不息；所以被围住的条件不能去掉。活动需要支持、有界传递与耗散在其中空成立。
detail.en: exposed: meets all eight premises, no step enclosed, and arising never ceases; so the condition of enclosure cannot be dropped. Activity needing support, bounded transmission and dissipation hold vacuously in it.

detail.zh: attrition：满足停息定理除活动的普查以外的每个前提，每步都围住所立者，止息复现；所以活动的普查不可少（World.rest_needs_census）。
detail.en: attrition: meets every premise of the rest theorem but the census of what is active, every step enclosed around what stands, and ceasing recurs; so that census is needed (World.rest_needs_census).

detail.zh: throughput 与 embodiedThroughput：每步都被围住、平衡、耗散，生起不息；throughput 有活动的普查与生起者体现而没有所立者的普查，embodiedThroughput 每个关系项体现而没有普查；所以每步立着的有限多不可少（World.rest_needs_standing）。
detail.en: throughput and embodiedThroughput: every step enclosed, balanced and dissipative, and arising never ceases; throughput has a census of what is active and embodied arising but no census of what stands, and embodiedThroughput has every relatum embodied but no census; so finitely many standing at each step is needed (World.rest_needs_standing).

detail.zh: 互利者：满足全部八个前提，每步都被围住，生起不复现；与 exposed 一起，八个前提既不决定被围住，也不决定开放（World.openness_contingent）。
detail.en: Mutualists: meet all eight premises, every step enclosed, and arising does not recur; with exposed, the eight premises decide neither enclosure nor openness (World.openness_contingent).

detail.zh: holding：满足全部八个前提，没有一步被围住，而什么都不生起、不止息；所以开放是生起不息的必要条件，不是充分条件（World.holding_world，独立审查 R8）。
detail.en: holding: meets all eight premises with no step enclosed, and nothing arises or ceases; so openness is necessary for arising without end, not sufficient (World.holding_world, the independent review's R8).

detail.zh: exchange_needs：Flow 的循环（被围住、平衡、不耗散）、leaking（被围住、耗散、不平衡）与 throughput（被围住、平衡、耗散，所立者不能被列出）中交换都在任意晚的步复现，exposed 中也是（满足八个前提，没有一步被围住）；所以交换归于停息的四个前提都不能去掉。
detail.en: exchange_needs: in the cycle of Becoming.Flow (enclosed, balanced, not dissipative), leaking (enclosed, dissipative, not balanced) and throughput (enclosed, balanced, dissipative, what stands not listable) the exchange recurs at arbitrarily late steps, as in exposed (all eight premises, no step enclosed); so none of the four premises of the exchange coming to rest can be dropped.

detail.zh: World.binding_contingent：hatch 中每个前提都起约束而生起停止；每步一个成员替换另一个的只闭合一次的队列中每个前提都起约束，生起与止息复现。
detail.en: World.binding_contingent: in hatch every premise binds and arising stops; in a queue closed once in which one member replaces another at every step every premise binds, and arising and ceasing recur.

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器实查（回执 20261013T094743.528770Z；外围 20261013T095049.338744Z 通过）：Becoming.Openness、Becoming.Counting、Becoming.Dissipation 与 Becoming.Locality 的定理（含本记录的局部规律）公理报告为空；检查器并核对核心纯净。作者反审见 §33 与 §35；第十次独立审查接受所审部分的数学，停息定理部分与其更正尚未经独立审查；第十一次接受其数学，其更正尚未再经审查。
validation_scope.en: Machine-checked by the consolidated Lean 4.29.1 checker (receipt 20261013T094743.528770Z; periphery 20261013T095049.338744Z passed): the theorems of Becoming.Openness, Becoming.Counting, Becoming.Dissipation and Becoming.Locality, with this record's local laws, have empty axiom reports; the checker verifies core purity. Author counterreview in §33 and §35; the tenth independent review accepts the mathematics of the part it reviewed, while the rest-theorem part and its corrections are not yet independently reviewed; the eleventh accepts its mathematics, its corrections not yet reviewed.

next_delta.zh: 带比率或连续量的总水平。
next_delta.en: Total standing with rates or continuous amounts.

correspondence.zh: space-and-its-parts 的 rests 用有限使世界的停息不能被否证；本结果说明世界本身不必有限：起作用的是每步立着的与活跃的有限多（两种普查），连同被围住所立者；有限世界在两点上起作用，给出普查，也给出被围住，这两点可以分开要求。throughput 与 embodiedThroughput 说明每步立着的有限多不能去掉，attrition 说明活动的普查不能去掉，exposed 说明被围住不能去掉，holding 说明开放不足以给出生起不息。rests_unrefuted 与这里的 rests_unrefuted_around 是同一个停息定理的两种情形：有限世界自动有两种普查并且每步都被围住，每个关系项都体现的世界中两种普查是同一个。作者的读法（AI 论证）：在平衡与耗散之下，所立者的总水平是一个只降不升的量；每次生起（体现时就是开始作为条件而在）与每次止息（体现时就是不再作为条件而在）都使它下降，所以在一个被围住、每步立着的有限多的展开中，水平的变化不在任意晚的步发生（活动的变化另需活动的普查，attrition）。这一推广的范围：在停息这样不能被否证的世界中，曾经立着或活跃的不是无界多（rest_few），它比 rests_unrefuted 多涵盖的只是从不立着、从不活动的关系项（第十一次独立审查 R3）。生起不息因此需要开放：并非从某步起每步都被围住，即与每个有限家族之外交换。这是 no-finite-part-bears-taking 与 generation-is-replenishment 中家族层面的“开放”在世界层面的陈述，并且用变化的所立者列表而不是固定的家族。在世界层面，开放是在每个有限家族之外的交换，不必有流入：exposed 的交换净量为零，总水平始终为一，无界的是与之交换的关系项的数目，各自水平为零；依 Ren 的交托，“开放”指每个有限家族之外的交换，流入是增益，另行陈述（DELEGATED-CHOICES D7；where-novelty-gain-comes-from）。exposed 中活动需要支持与有界传递因为没有依存而空成立，耗散因为没有一步被围住而空成立；停息定理只用其中四个前提。耗散只约束被围住的交换是其表示的已披露的特点（Spray，见第六次独立审查之后的更正）。“开放”“被围住”“所立者”的读法与名称是 AI 的表述，按 Ren 的命名规则采用（DELEGATED-CHOICES D36）；本结果不评价开放或停息。
correspondence.en: The rests of space-and-its-parts makes a world's rest unrefutable through finiteness; this result shows that the world itself need not be finite: what does the work is finitely many standing and finitely many active at each step (the two censuses), with enclosure around what stands; finiteness works in two ways, giving the censuses and giving enclosure, and the two can be asked for separately. throughput and embodiedThroughput show that finitely many standing at each step cannot be dropped, attrition that the census of what is active cannot, and exposed that enclosure cannot, while holding shows that openness does not suffice for arising without end. rests_unrefuted and rests_unrefuted_around here are two cases of one rest theorem: a finite world has both censuses and is enclosed at every step, and where every relatum is embodied the two censuses are one. The author's reading (an AI argument): under balance and dissipation the total standing is a quantity that falls and never rises; every arising (for an embodied relatum, coming to stand) and every ceasing (for an embodied relatum, ceasing to stand) lowers it, so in an unfolding enclosed and with finitely many standing at each step, changes of standing do not happen at arbitrarily late steps (changes of activity need the census of activity as well, attrition). The reach of this generalization: in a world whose rest is so unrefuted, not unboundedly many relata ever stand or act (rest_few), so it covers beyond rests_unrefuted only relata that never stand or act (the eleventh independent review's R3). Arising without end therefore needs openness: not every step from some step on enclosed, that is, exchange beyond every finite family. This is the family-level openness of no-finite-part-bears-taking and generation-is-replenishment stated of worlds, over the changing list of what stands rather than a fixed family. At world level openness is exchange beyond every finite family and need not be inflow: exposed exchanges at zero net, its total standing stays at one, and what is unbounded is the number of relata it exchanges with, each at zero; on Ren's delegation ‘openness’ names exchange beyond every finite family, and inflow is gain, stated separately (DELEGATED-CHOICES D7; where-novelty-gain-comes-from). In exposed, activity needing support and bounded transmission hold vacuously, since nothing depends on anything, and dissipation holds vacuously, since no step is enclosed; the rest theorem uses four premises. That dissipation binds only enclosed exchange is a disclosed feature of its representation (Spray, from the corrections after the sixth independent review). The readings and names of ‘openness’, ‘enclosed’ and ‘what stands’ are the AI's formulations, adopted under Ren's naming rule (DELEGATED-CHOICES D36); the result evaluates neither openness nor rest.

detail.zh: 复用耗散、被围住的步、跨过被耗散的步家族的存量下降（Balances.runs_down），以及可判定相等时被围住的步围住任何家族（Enclosed.around）。
detail.en: Reuses dissipation, enclosed steps, a family's stock running down across a step dissipated on (Balances.runs_down), and that with equality decided an enclosed step is enclosed around any family (Enclosed.around).

output.zh: 被耗散的家族的存量下降至少为取用它的形成数；被围住的步围住任何家族。
output.en: A family dissipated on runs down by at least the number of formations taking from it; an enclosed step is enclosed around any family.

input.zh: 所立者的总水平不上升，任何水平变化都使它下降。
input.en: The total standing never rises, and every change of standing lowers it.

conditions.zh: 平衡；耗散；所立者被列出；步围住所立者。
conditions.en: Balance; dissipation; what stands listed; the step enclosed around it.

detail.zh: 复用上升降低存量（rise_lowers_on）、开始作为条件而在即上升（ComesToStand.rises）与 Shuttle 的见证。
detail.en: Reuses that a rise lowers the stock (rise_lowers_on), that coming to stand is a rise (ComesToStand.rises), and the Shuttle witness.

output.zh: 被耗散的家族中成员上升时存量下降；Shuttle 的两侧来回传递水平，生起不息。
output.en: A member rising lowers a family's stock under dissipation; the sides of Shuttle hand a standing back and forth and keep arising without end.

input.zh: 上升使总水平下降；exposed 中的两侧。
input.en: A rise lowers the total standing; the sides in exposed.

detail.zh: 复用平衡的流中每次下降都被取用（Balances.fall_taken）。
detail.en: Reuses that in a balanced flow every fall is taken from (Balances.fall_taken).

output.en: A falling condition is taken from.

input.en: A fall lowers the total standing.

detail.zh: 复用八个前提（Premised）、普查（Counted）与列表工具（beyond）。
detail.en: Reuses the eight premises (Premised), the census (Counted) and the list tool beyond.

input.zh: 满足全部八个前提而生起不息的世界；世界层面的停息定理的前提。
input.en: A world meeting all eight premises in which arising does not cease; the premises of the world-level rest theorems.

detail.zh: 复用世界、生起复现与止息复现（ArisingRecurs、CeasingRecurs）与体现（Embodied）。
detail.en: Reuses worlds, arising recurring and ceasing recurring (ArisingRecurs, CeasingRecurs) and embodiment (Embodied).

input.zh: 被围住的世界归于停息。
input.en: An enclosed world comes to rest.

input.zh: 体现的关系项止息时其水平下降。

detail.zh: 复用普查之下止息复现需要生起复现（World.arising_of_ceasing）。
detail.en: Reuses that under a census recurring ceasing needs recurring arising (World.arising_of_ceasing).

output.zh: 有普查、活动可判定的世界中，止息复现就有生起复现。
output.en: In a world with a census whose activity is decided, recurring ceasing comes with recurring arising.

input.zh: 生起停止时止息也停止，所以停息定理只要求生起者体现。
input.en: Where arising stops, ceasing stops, so the rest theorem needs only whatever arises embodied.

conditions.zh: 活动的普查；活动可判定。
conditions.en: A census of what is active; decided activity.

detail.zh: 证明改经一步的规律：水平的停息定理（change_stops_unrefuted_around、exchange_not_recurring_around、standing_never_rises、change_lowers、exchange_lowers、standing_runs_down、fall_lowers_on），前提给出的条件见 Flow.AroundStanding.runsDownClosed；Web.StandingCensus 与 stock_eq 移入 Becoming.Locality。
detail.en: The proofs now go through the laws of one step: the standing rest theorems (change_stops_unrefuted_around, exchange_not_recurring_around, standing_never_rises, change_lowers, exchange_lowers, standing_runs_down, fall_lowers_on), the premises supplying the condition by Flow.AroundStanding.runsDownClosed; Web.StandingCensus and stock_eq moved into Becoming.Locality.

output.zh: 跨过包含所立者、被平衡与耗散的家族下降的一步，水平改变恰当总水平下降；所立者有普查时，变化复现恰当它在不下降的步上复现。
output.en: Across a step at which a family holding what stands, balanced and dissipated on, runs down, some standing changes exactly when the total falls; under a census of what stands, change recurs exactly where it recurs across steps that do not run down.

input.zh: 围住所立者的步上，前提给出下降（Flow.AroundStanding.runsDownClosed），所以被围住的步上变化归于停息。
input.en: Across a step enclosed around what stands the premises give the running down (Flow.AroundStanding.runsDownClosed), so change comes to rest across enclosed steps.

conditions.zh: 所立者的普查；平衡；耗散；步围住所立者。
conditions.en: A census of what stands; balance; dissipation; the step enclosed around it.

detail.zh: 完成计划 P25：生起不息需要开放的形式陈述；这不是无公理的整体演绎。
detail.en: Completes plan P25: the formal statement that arising without end needs openness; this is not the deduction of the whole without axioms.

detail.zh: 那里的 rests 以有限为前提；停息定理以普查与被围住代替有限，rests_unrefuted 陈述它对有限世界的结论（P26）。
detail.en: rests there assumes finiteness; the rest theorem replaces finiteness with censuses and enclosure, and rests_unrefuted states its conclusion of finite worlds (P26).

detail.zh: 开放是交换，流入是增益：那里给出新需要的增益从哪里来。
detail.en: Openness is exchange and inflow is gain: there, where the gain novelty needs comes from.

No law, premise, status, proof binding or source hash changed. The old text named the standing law stills, which no current declaration bears; law 3 cites Flow.change_stops_unrefuted_around, the theorem the next step named as this record's standing rest theorem, and the hypotheses keep the old name. The local restatements appended to the next step became laws 23 and 24. In the correspondence, section and round labels give way to the records they name (section 30: space-and-its-parts; sections 17 and 20: no-finite-part-bears-taking and generation-is-replenishment; P26 dropped; section 22: the corrections after the sixth independent review). The second hypothesis was split at its sentences, wording unchanged. Every earlier sentence is mapped in the migration table [continued-change-needs-openness.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/development/becoming-general-laws-plan/readability/migrations/continued-change-needs-openness.md); the exact earlier record is the last text_versions entry.

history.en: 17 October 2026, whole-repository review of 16–17 October 2026 (CHANGES.md), items A1, A4: the statement said the world "comes to rest", while the Lean (World.comes_to_rest_unrefuted, rests_unrefuted_enclosed) proves only ¬¬∃N, RestsFrom N; it now says the world "cannot be refuted to come to rest", the exchange "does not recur" (a negated recurrence). World.arising_opens concludes ¬∀t≥T, Enclosed t, so law 16's positive gloss "it exchanges beyond every finite family" becomes "it is enclosed from no step on". The same wording is fixed in does_not_show 1 (World.rest_few assumes the rest theorem's conditions, not rest) and in the correspondence. Earlier text in text_versions.
